name: Admin View Map
description: Open the panel route inventory, filter grouped views, and copy route references for support and QA communication. Includes the interactive map mode: Lista/Mapa toggle, module cards with stats, drill-down into curated sub-modules, and deep-linking via ?viewMode=map&module=<id>. Ships seeded filter tabs (Admin, Público, Cliente, Dashboards, Configuración) and a Configuración section that persists the default view mode and default filters in the ViewMapSettings backend singleton; ?viewMode= overrides the configured default and localStorage no longer persists the last-used mode.
knownGaps: Configuración default-filters autosave (debounced PATCH + toast) and default-filters application on open are unit-covered only (2026-07 audit).
Saved-tab CRUD (create/rename/delete) unasserted on view_map; shared ProposalFilterTabs component is exercised in proposals specs (2026-07 audit).
